**Issue #4837 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4837: Patch: a play naming an X above the player's mana is refused before its targets are drawn at random, so a huge X cannot overflow under a Mayor
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

While Meditative #86 Mayor Medinamogger acts (R1200: every target is drawn at random), `validate_play` (`crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs:627`) draws a play's random targets **before** `why_choices_refused` has checked the play's X. A script that reads X while its targets are resolved then runs on a value nobody has bounded.

With a Mayor on the field and S #99 No-No Words in hand, a client that sends `play { x: 2147483647 }` reaches `param(&args, "per") * x_of(args.self_)` in `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c099_no_no_words.rs:29`:

- a build with overflow checks panics inside `reduce`: "attempt to multiply with overflow";
- the shipped builds wrap (the root `Cargo.toml`'s release profile sets no `overflow-checks`), and the X check then refuses the play, so **no shipped game is affected today**.

Without a Mayor, X is refused first and nothing overflows. The listed plays never carry such an X (infinite mana does not widen X, R3548004), so only a hand-written message gets here.

It is filed because the order is wrong, not because of the one card: any script that reads X during the random draw runs on an unchecked number, and the next such script may not wrap harmlessly.

### What should happen

SPEC §9.3 and §10.2: "a refused action comes back with the input state, no events and its message", with no panic. R348: an X above the spendable mana is refused ("X is above your current mana").

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `finding_a_play_naming_a_huge_x_is_refused_not_a_panic_while_a_mayor_acts`, in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_engine_plays.rs` at 022f83d](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/022f83d/crates/ai/tests/audit_engine_plays.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`).

```rust
use std::panic::{AssertUnwindSafe, catch_unwind};
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const P1: PlayerId = PlayerId::P1;

#[test]
fn a_play_naming_a_huge_x_is_refused_not_a_panic_while_a_mayor_acts() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let s = scenario(json!({
        "p1": { "hand": ["stinkyscape-099"], "mana": 4 },
        "p2": { "hand": ["core-008"], "field": ["meditative-086", "core-008"] },
    }));
    let state = s.state().clone();
    let play = PlayAction { instance_id: state.players[P1].hand[0].id.clone(), x: Some(i32::MAX), ..Default::default() };
    let action = Action::new(play.into_body(), P1, "huge-x");
    let outcome = catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| reduce(&state, &action)));
    assert!(outcome.as_ref().is_ok_and(|result| result.error.is_some()),
        "reduce must refuse X = i32::MAX, not panic: {:?}",
        outcome.map(|result| result.error).map_err(|payload| payload.downcast_ref::<String>().cloned()));
}
```

Output today: `panicked at crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c099_no_no_words.rs:29:17: attempt to multiply with overflow`.

### Where

The rules engine: `crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs` (`validate_play`'s order under R1200).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- In `validate_play`, run the X check before the Mayor's target draw. That is the whole fix; a saturating product in the one script would only hide the order.
- Check the same order for the other numbers a play carries that a script may read during the draw (a Plague spend, an Embiggen flag): the property run that found this forged each field of every listed play of all 979 shipped cards on eight boards and panicked on the Mayor board alone, on X alone.
- The draw itself must stay where a refused play leaves the rng cursor untouched (a refusal returns the input state).
- Add the test to the engine's rule tests under R348 and R1200.

Found by an audit of how cards are played; the reproduction was run and the code path read before filing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45544438392)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A play naming an X above the player's spendable mana is refused **before** the Mayor's random-target draw runs, so no script ever reads an unbounded X. The fix is an order change in `validate_play`: run the X check (and the Embiggen-flag check beside it) before the draw. One regression test proves a huge X under a Mayor is refused with the input state back, no events and no panic; one control test proves a legal X still draws and resolves under a Mayor.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs` | change | `validate_play`: call the X and Embiggen pre-checks before the Mayor draw block; reword the draw comment's first line ("before anything is checked or paid" is no longer true). No other logic moves. |
| `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` | change | `refuse_x` and `refuse_embiggen`: `fn` → `pub(crate) fn`. No logic change. |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/mb22.rs` | change | Two tests (names below); import `nono_x` and `register_spell_verb_fixtures` from `super::fixtures::spell_verbs`. |
| `spec/rulings/R0348.md` | change | `proven_in`: add `crates/engine/tests/rules/mb22.rs`. Front matter only; body untouched. |

Do not touch: `crates/cards` (no saturating product in any script — the issue rejects that as hiding the order), any other spec note body, `spec/history/`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, `spec/pending/` (no new ruling: R348 plus R1200 already decide this), or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §9.3, §10.2 (refused action returns input state, no events), §10.5 step 1, R348 (1 ≤ X ≤ spendable mana, "X is above your current mana"), R1200 (draw at step 1 before anything is paid), R703 (the fixture's pick is required), R1868000 (target checks read the play's X).

## Steps

1. In `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`, change `fn refuse_x(` (line 2732) to `pub(crate) fn refuse_x(` and `fn refuse_embiggen(` (line 2771) to `pub(crate) fn refuse_embiggen(`. Copy no pattern; it is a visibility-only edit.
2. In `crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs` `validate_play`, immediately after `let mut owned = action.clone();` and before the `if crate::random_targets::play_targets_random(...)` block, insert (X first, matching the order inside `why_choices_refused` at lines 3067–3068):
   ```rust
   // R348: the play's own numbers are checked before any script can read them. R1200's draw
   // below runs the declarations' named checks against the X-stamped face, so an unbounded X
   // would reach them (S #99's check multiplies by it). A Plague spend travels on no face the
   // draw reads, so its check stays below.
   crate::play_choices::refuse_x(sink.state, player, &card, owned.x)?;
   crate::play_choices::refuse_embiggen(sink.state, &card, owned.embiggen)?;
   ```
   Keep the existing `refuse_x`/`refuse_embiggen` calls inside `why_choices_refused` in place; the early call is a repeat so scripts never see an unbounded number, the later call stays the single full check. In the same edit, change the R1200 comment's first line from "draw each at random before anything is checked or paid" to "draw each at random before anything is paid".
3. Verify the Plague/Tribute claim in step 2's comment before keeping it: search the draw path (`with_drawn_target_picks` → `legal_selections_for` → `card_allowed`, `reachable`, `targeting::target_aim`, plus `face_for_action` → `stamped_for_play`, `cost_with`, `resolving_face`) for any read of `plague`, `PlagueSpend`, or tribute counts. None is expected (only the X/Embiggen-stamped face reaches the checks; Tributes are instance ids, not numbers). If the search finds a read, pre-check that number too; otherwise keep the comment as written.
4. Verify no other reducer path draws targets with a hand-written X: search callers of `with_drawn_target_picks`. Expected: only `validate_play`; the listing path uses `legal_x_values` (already bounded, R348) and random casts use the caster's mana (R452). Report if otherwise.
5. In `crates/engine/tests/rules/mb22.rs`, add the import `use super::fixtures::spell_verbs::{nono_x, register_spell_verb_fixtures};` and these two tests (helpers `playing`, `put`, `slot`, `in_hand`, `reduce`, `json_as`, `on_field`, `P1`, `Row` are already imported/defined in that file; copy the local `says` helper from `crates/engine/tests/rules/turn.rs` lines 19–21):
   - `fn r1200_r348_huge_x_is_refused_before_the_draw()`: `let mut state = playing("mb22-huge-x");` then `register_spell_verb_fixtures();`, put `fx::mayor` at `slot(P1, Row::Units, 1)`, put `fx::ally` (1/4, so the `belowFourX` check has a candidate and would multiply by X during the draw) at `slot(P2, Row::Units, 1)`, `let hunter = in_hand(&mut state, &nono_x.id, P1, 1).remove(0);`, set `state.players.p1.mana.current = 4;`, clone `before`, then `reduce` a `play` body with `"x": i32::MAX` and a nonce. Assert the error contains "X is above your current mana", `result.events` is empty, and `result.state == before` (this covers the rng cursor: `rng_cursor` is a state field and refusal returns the input clone, per `reduce_held` in `crates/engine/src/reduce.rs`). Pre-fix this test panics with "attempt to multiply with overflow".
   - `fn r1200_r348_a_legal_x_still_draws_under_a_mayor()`: same board, play with `"x": 2` (limit 4×2 = 8 > 4, so the pick is legal; cost 2 ≤ mana 4). Assert `result.error` is `None` and `!on_field(&result.state, &ally_id)`.
6. In `spec/rulings/R0348.md` `proven_in`, add the line `  - crates/engine/tests/rules/mb22.rs` (alphabetical among the existing entries is not required; append last). `mb22.rs` is already in R1200's `proven_in`, so no R1200 edit is needed; the new test names hold both the `r1200` and `r348` tokens between underscores, satisfying `spec check`.

## Tests

- New tests: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r1200_r348` — both tests pass; confirm the first fails (panics) with the step-2 insert reverted.
- Neighbors: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r1200` and `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r348`.
- Then `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] A play with `x: i32::MAX` under a Mayor is refused with "X is above your current mana", empty events, and the exact input state (rng cursor included) — no panic in debug, no wrap-then-refuse in release.
- [ ] A legal X under a Mayor still draws its target at random and resolves.
- [ ] Face-down plays are unchanged (they draw nothing; their X check already runs first).
- [ ] The draw-reachability search in step 3 is done and the comment matches what it found.
- [ ] Both new tests pass, the `r1200` and `r348` neighbors pass, and fmt, clippy, and `spec check` are green.
- [ ] No card script, spec body, catalog, or forbidden path changed.

## Risks

- Determinism/replay: the pre-check touches no rng, so a refused play leaves the cursor exactly where the input state had it; the normal Mayor draw path is untouched. The control test guards the reorder.
- Hidden information and the client: no view, listing, or wire change; `legal_actions` already offers only bounded X values, so offered plays behave as before.
- Rejected alternatives: a saturating product in S #99's script (hides the order; the issue forbids it), clamping X inside `face_for_action` (would alter option enumeration instead of refusing), moving the whole `why_choices_refused` before the draw (zone/tribute/target checks need the drawn picks and run no script arithmetic on unbounded numbers).

## Open questions

- Hard, not medium: the hardness rule names the engine rules and the resolution loop (`crates/engine/src/`), and this change is in `validate_play` — plan, build, and review it as hard. Otherwise none: every behavior the task asks for is decided by R348, R1200, §9.3, and §10.2, so no person decision is needed.
````
